collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Viano 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz Viano Van 2003 to 2005 (639) will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Viano which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
